title: Register an Account
summary: Add a relationship with a Provider to your World so capabilities can use it.

params.name: provider
params.explain: The external service the Account belongs to.

params.name: label
params.explain: Your name for this Account, such as Work or Personal.

consequence.explain: Only your local World changes. In D1 the Account is synthetic: no login happens and no identity is verified.

evidence.explain: A synthetic registration is not an authenticated Account.
